article.story: Washington (5-4) at Michigan State (3-6), Nov. 14 at 4:15 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Washington by 3.5. Against the spread: Washington 3-6, Michigan State 5-3-1. How to watch: BTN Key stats Washington Offense Overall: 364.4 yards per game (83rd in FBS) Passing: 265.1 yards per game (27th) Rushing: 99.3 yards per game (131st) Scoring: 26.3 points per game (82nd) Washington Defense Overall: 350.4 yards per game (60th in FBS) Passing: 214.4 yards per game (65th) Rushing: 136.0 yards per game (62nd) Scoring: 21.9 points per game (46th) Michigan State Offense Overall: 292.1 yards per game (133rd in FBS) Passing: 182.0 yards per game (117th) Rushing: 110.1 yards per game (125th) Scoring: 19.3 points per game (127th) Michigan State Defense Overall: 337.0 yards per game (43rd in FBS) Passing: 194.3 yards per game (43rd) Rushing: 142.7 yards per game (69th) Scoring: 23.6 points per game (59th) Washington is 120th in third down percentage, converting 33.3% of the time. Michigan State is 87th in the FBS with a -2 turnover margin, compared to Washington's 28th-ranked +4 margin. Washington ranks 88th in the FBS averaging 60.9 penalty yards per game, compared to Michigan State's 26th-ranked 44.8 per-game average. Michigan State is 98th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 87.5% of trips. Washington's red zone offense ranks 35th, scoring on 89.5% of red zone opportunities. Team leaders Washington Passing: Demond Williams Jr., 1,667 yards, 11 TDs, 4 INTs, 64.5 completion percentage Rushing: Brian Bonner Jr., 318 yards on 72 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Chris Lawson, 727 yards on 49 catches, 3 TDs Michigan State Passing: Alessio Milivojevic, 1,451 yards, 7 TDs, 3 INTs, 65.4 completion percentage Rushing: Jaziun Patterson, 327 yards on 76 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Chrishon McCray, 381 yards on 35 catches, 1 TD Last game Washington was beaten by Penn State 28-25 on Nov. 7. Williams passed for 172 yards on 19-of-33 attempts (57.6%) with two touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball five times for 43 yards. Jayden Limar had 66 rushing yards on nine carries, adding two receptions for 11 yards. Lawson had five receptions for 89 yards. Michigan State defeated Michigan 15-6 on Nov. 7. Milivojevic led Michigan State with 188 yards on 21-of-32 passing (65.6%) for no touchdowns and no interceptions. Brandon Tullis carried the ball 25 times for 86 yards, adding three receptions for three yards. McCray had six receptions for 92 yards. Next game Washington hosts No. 6 Indiana on Nov. 21. Michigan State hosts No. 18 Oregon on Nov. 20.
